build_optimizer_and_scheduler: build an AdamW optimizer and linear warmup scheduler for a PyTorch model using config parameters
create_VSLNet_model: create a VSLNet model instance with video projection, feature encoder, and conditioned predictor layers
run_VSLNet_forward: run the VSLNet forward pass with video features, masks, and dual text features to get highlight scores and logits
compute_VSLNet_loss: compute the cross entropy loss for start and end logits against ground truth labels using VSLNet
extract_VSLNet_index: extract start and end indices from predicted logits using the VSLNet extract_index method
